notes.title: Sale Alert! Whisker Squadron: Survivor - Meet Minibosses!
notes.content:
[b]Attention all Race the Sun fans![/b]

Are you ready to embark on a thrilling new adventure? Introducing Whisker Squadron: Survivor, Flippfly's cosmic roguelite on-rails shooter!

In Whisker Squadron: Survivor, you command a fearless feline flight crew on heart-pounding 30-minute runs through the cosmos. Your mission? Seek vengeance on the Swarm and survive against all odds. It's a wild ride where every run is a fresh, randomized adventure filled with excitement and challenge. You might even encounter some familiar environments...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5347280/f71c90cc2f253fccfc6581be8a2719b35746baa0.gif[/img]

But that's not all! For a limited time only, Whisker Squadron: Survivor is on sale this week as we celebrate the addition of epic miniboss fights that will test your skills like never before. Each encounter is a cinematic showdown that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5347280/ab12e63805c1ac14da28514676afeee58ec2d144.gif[/img]

Don't let the sun set on this incredible offer - grab your copy now and soar into the unknown!

notes.title: New Game from Race The Sun developer: Whisker Squadron
notes.content:
We're thrilled to tell you about our new game, Whisker Squadron! It has the same DNA as Race The Sun, but this game is all about insane shooting action in a procedurally-generated mission. If you liked [i]Race The Sun[/i], or classics like [i]Star Fox[/i], you are definitely going to want to put this on your Wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1303400/Whisker_Squadron/

The demo is available now until Feb 10th as part of the Steam Festival. Give it a try and let us know what you think[url=https://discord.gg/flippfly] in our Discord[/url]!

Features: A cast of feline pilots, each with their own special weapons. Here is Olivia, firing off a volley of homing missiles:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5347280/0782db4504570c3ba33cde529d769c7e63583e09.gif[/img]

Procedurally-generated bosses!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5347280/c1e7a4201e26a27cbbfe5ea9b38f51e78645ee6a.gif[/img]

The game is structured as a Roguelike: You get one life to complete your mission, and there are randomized upgrades and tactical choices to make along the way.

notes.title: Version 1.50 released
notes.content:
Hi folks. We'd like to let you know that we just released a new build. This build includes some new daily portal worlds (thanks for the feedback on that!) As well as some misc. bug fixes and optimizations. 

Some notes:

- You may notice some odd connectivity issues today and tomorrow, as the backend server for the game's leaderboards/daily updates has changed.

 
- We had to upgrade the underlying game engine with this update. This usually means the game runs smoother for folks, and often fixes some rare bugs; but it might also break compatibility on some much older PCs or OSs. If this is you, let us know and we'll try to help.

- Some people have reported a score exploit, as well as some suspicously high scores on the leaderboard. We've fixed the exploit in this build, and we'll be resetting the all-time and daily leaderboards tomorrow.

Also: Thanks for those who have (very) patiently been waiting for the promised VR update. This game engine upgrade was an important step towards that, and we hope to have a build ready for you very soon.

notes.title: We solved the Android problem for Race The Sun
notes.content:
[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Ceuh9baWAAAl8nh.jpg][/img]

[url=http://flippfly.com/a-problem-with-race-the-sun/]Just posted about this on our website[/url] and shared it on [url=https://twitter.com/Flippfly]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/Flippfly]Facebook[/url], etc.

We have been working on an Android version of Race the Sun, and it will be ready for release on Google Play soon. We are still working out the details of a release date and exactly what devices we can support, but we know that the game will have the same features as the iOS version, including leaderboards, achievements, and a world that regenerates daily.

[h1]Android Beta Testers Wanted[/h1]

[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CeumWRHXIAEgKXJ.jpg][/img]

We will be running a closed beta for those who want to test the game early. You can [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1R40vz1eHuUHHCe5Twl7-HhNfO7YZupIplMAC2_o-UFU/viewform]sign up here[/url] if you would like to ​apply to be a beta tester.

Thanks to everyone who has requested an Android version — we are super pumped that we can finally make it happen.

notes.title: Race The Sun developer Flippfly wants you to pick its next project
notes.content:
Race the Sun developer Flippfly wants you to vote for its next game project, by playing a bunch of prototypes the team has made over the last couple of years, and then picking the ones you'd like to see turned into fuller games.

Each round of the 'Prototype Showdown' offers two potential games for your consideration. Round one pits TaxiCopter ("The sun, the sea, a chopper who could ask for more!") against Dupi's Wrong Turn ("A little game about a little egg in space…and funny gravity"), and you still have 14 days at the time of writing to download each game, log into the Flippfly site, and vote. TaxiCopter currently has 79% of the votes, and I reckon it looks the most fun.

You can see footage of both prototypes in the following video, which also offers a nice overview of how the tournament is going to work. It's basically Highlander, but with prototypes. There can only be one.

notes.title: Race The Sun 1.455 released
notes.content:
Hey all, thanks for your bug reports, suggestions, and patience! This build includes lots of bug fixes, as well as a few requested features.

Partial list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added "No Vsync" option
[*] Improved collision detection w/powerups
[*] Added selectable controller profiles, and slightly better controller detection, as well as a "reset" option.
[*] Added input reset hotkey: Hold C on main menu for 3 seconds.
[*] Powerups should now spawn more consistently between rounds
[*] Fixed glitch when sun goes down while holding a shield
[*] Fixed bugs where powerups from portal would still be present in main world
[*] Fixed achievement bug where certain achievements showed progress incorrectly
[*] Fix for rare crash when entering portal
[*] Upgraded Unity engine to 5.1.3, which shoudl bring some performance improvements in Linux, potentially fix some rare crashes, etc.
[*] Optimized loading time for Sunrise DLC mode.
[*] Fixed OSX icon
[/list]

notes.title: Going Going Gone: Race The Sun Is Free For One Day
notes.content:
That there Race the Sun [official site] is a fine game. You skim across abstract landscapes in a solar-powered vehicle, trying desperately to outrun the impending sunset while not smashing into the odd architecture like a ruddy great fool. It’s fast and exciting. I’d recommend you pay money for it, and I’ll certainly recommend you snag it for free.

To celebration the launch of an iOS version (and its new chillout DLC on PC), developers Fippfly have made Race the Sun free for one day. Head on over to Steam to nab it and it’ll be yours forever.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Race the Sun is free on Steam, but only for a day
notes.content:
Race the Sun is a procedurally-generated endless runner in which you take control of a solar-powered aircraft and fly it through increasingly difficult obstacle courses at what feels like increasingly ludicrous speeds, all while trying to keep pace with a slowly setting sun. It's simple but really quite good, in a 'shouting surprised obscenities as you smash into a wall' kind of way, and today—and only today—it's free.

The freebie marks the release of Race the Sun on the App Store, although Aaron San Filippo, the co-founder of developer Flippfly, described it as a "crazy experiment" on Twitter. It also follows closely on the release of the Sunrise DLC, a "'zen' type mode" of play that eliminates the setting sun, increasing difficulty levels, and leaderboards. At the same time, the game was updated to add a first-person camera view and "High Scores in the Sky," which lets you literally fly past your friends' high scores.

Race the Sun is free now and will remain so until 1 pm PDT on July 31, which is tomorrow. Grab it from Steam.

notes.title: Sunrise DLC for Race The Sun is here!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

[i]First, before I get into the good stuff, let me just officially introduce myself. My name is Drew and I am the new Flippfly Community & Customer Support Manager. This means you'll start to see me join discussions and post announcements like these. Don't worry, I'm sure you'll still hear from Aaron and Forest some, too.

I'm also the first person you speak with over at our [url=http://flippfly.freshdesk.com/]support forum[/url] and through our primary [url=https://twitter.com/Flippfly]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Flippfly]Facebook[/url] accounts. I will be lurking everywhere. ...But enough about me![/i]

[h1][url=http://store.steampowered.com/dlc/253030/]Sunrise DLC[/url][/h1]

[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CK8c8frWwAAjFVd.png:large][/img]

For some time, our players have been asking for a "zen" type mode for Race The Sun. And we’ve been listening! Today we launched a $1.99 DLC here on Steam, called [url=http://store.steampowered.com/dlc/253030/]Sunrise[/url]. This beautiful new mode has all the speed of the original but without a setting sun, an increasing difficulty, or a leaderboard. Just settle in and zone out for one infinite region of bliss. [url=http://store.steampowered.com/dlc/253030/]Go check it out![/url]

We’re looking forward to hear what you think! Please leave us your comments!

[h1]RTS Update[/h1]

Along with this newly available DLC, we have also made some updates to the game including new features we think you're going to love!

[list]
[*] First-Person Camera Mode: at the press of a button ("c" on your keyboard by default) race with a cockpit view from within the ship!
[*] Friend's Highscores in the Sky: now you can literally see yourself passing your friend’s scores without leaving the main course!
[/list]

We're very excited about these updates and hope you are, too! Please let us know what you think of the new features.

And I look forward to talking with you in the Discussions section. If you ever experience any strange behavior with Race The Sun or need help with your Flippfly account or other Flippfly products, please head over to our [url=http://flippfly.freshdesk.com/]support forum[/url] and I will see what I can do for you.

You can also say hello to us via [url=https://twitter.com/Flippfly]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Flippfly]Facebook[/url].

Until next time,
— Drew

Race The Sun Fan + Flippfly Community & Customer Support Manager

[i]Thank you all for your thoughts and feedback as we update, fix and improve Race the Sun![/i]

- The Flippfly Team

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Race The Sun
notes.content:
Race The Sun is Now Available on Steam!
You are a solar craft. The sun is your death timer. Hurtle towards the sunset at breakneck speed in a futile race against time. Delay the inevitable by catching energy boosts which reverse the setting sun - if only for a moment.

Race The Sun is inspired by arcade games of the past with a focus on highscores, short game sessions, and a sense of pure fun mingled with a nerve-wracking tension. The rules are simple: don't crash, stay in the light, and don't slow down!
